fields.title: Module 3 | Motivation & 28-Day Goals
fields.label: Module 3 | Motivation & 28-Day Goals
fields.subtitle: This section helps identify your underlying challenges and the key outcomes you want to achieve over these 28 days.

fields.title: Which issues would you most like to resolve first?
fields.label: Which issues would you most like to resolve first?
fields.subtitle: Please select 1-3 items that concern you most.
options: Constantly feeling fatigued and low on energy
Getting hungry easily, craving food right after eating
Late-night food cravings and lack of control
Irregular daily schedule and poor sleep
Daytime brain fog and poor concentration
Noticeable waist/belly expansion or feeling physically heavy
Not eating much, but body shape and state are still unsatisfactory
Emotional instability, prone to feeling overwhelmed under stress
Constipation, bloating, or chronic digestive discomfort
Declining daytime energy/mental sharpness, less efficient at work than before
No major health issues; looking to build a structured, high-energy lifestyle

fields.title: What changes do you most hope to see after 28 days?
fields.label: What changes do you most hope to see after 28 days?
fields.subtitle: Please select 1-3 items that matter most to you.
options: More stable daytime energy, without crashing after a busy day
Easier to fall asleep at night, no middle-of-the-night waking, noticeably improved sleep quality
More stable daytime hunger and appetite
Less mindless snacking or overeating in the evening
Lighter body, reduced waist and abdominal size
More stable daily rhythm and emotional state
Clearer mind during the day, higher productivity and focus
Easier to manage diet and eating habits
Entering a sustainable state of continuous improvement
Satisfying change in weight/waist (you may write numerical goals in 'Other')

fields.title: Which of the following past weight loss / management experiences have you had? (Select all that apply)
fields.label: Which of the following past weight loss / management experiences have you had? (Select all that apply)
fields.subtitle: Select all that apply.
options: Prolonged severe calorie restriction or fasting | intermittent fasting, skipping dinner, one meal a day, deliberate starvation
Long-term zero/very low carb diet | almost completely eliminating rice, noodles, and grains
Long-term monotonous diet | only eating boiled vegetables, boiled eggs, meal replacements, unable to eat normal meals
Tried various 'rapid weight loss' products | candies, jellies, enzyme drinks, weight loss pills
Relied on laxatives, diarrhea, or appetite suppressants that caused physical discomfort
Repeatedly switching products/methods | effective at first, then losing effectiveness over time
Successfully lost significant weight before, but experienced rebound/regain
Methods were too extreme; easily derailed when life became busy or during social meals
Repeated weight loss and rebound cycles, leading to declining confidence in weight loss
Required high workout volume to maintain weight, rebounding as soon as exercise stopped
Have never seriously attempted weight loss before
Have had successful weight loss experiences that were maintained long-term

fields.title: What are you most worried might prevent you from sticking to the 28-day program?
fields.label: What are you most worried might prevent you from sticking to the 28-day program?
options: Prone to breaking diet in the evening
Tendency to look for quick shortcuts
Losing momentum after a few days, lacking perseverance
Wanting too many outcomes at once, unsure where to prioritize
